reason: I'd use the free first visit and maybe bring my moms group once on a weekday morning at the $8 a child rate. I would not pay $13 a kid on my own, that adds up fast on one shift income.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? $13 a kid every time is a lot when we're stretched, and I don't know why it's worth paying more than what's already around here.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the cleaning and limited-capacity promise actually hold up at the free visit, plus the group rate kept at $8 with 4 families, would get me to bring the group more than once.
